messages.content:
## Ma Huang Tang (麻黄汤)

**Ma Huang Tang** [1] is a formula from the Shang Han Lun composed of **麻黄 (9g)**, **桂枝 (9g)**, **杏仁 (9g)**, and **甘草 (6g)** [1]. It is indicated for Tai Yang stage exterior cold patterns presenting with **no sweating, aversion to cold, fever, body aches, wheezing, and a floating tight pulse** [1]. Its functions are to release the exterior, promote perspiration, and relieve wheezing and coughing [1].

Formula: 麻黄汤 (Ma Huang Tang, Ephedra Decoction)
Composition: 麻黄 (Ma Huang, 9g), 桂枝 (Gui Zhi, 9g), 杏仁 (Xing Ren, 9g), 甘草 (Gan Cao, 6g)
Roles: 麻黄 as Jun (Chief), 桂枝 as Chen (Minister), 杏仁 as Zuo (Assistant), 甘草 as Shi (Envoy)
Indications: Exterior cold with wheezing, aversion to cold, fever, no sweating, body aches, floating tight pulse
Functions: Releases the exterior, promotes perspiration, relieves wheezing, stops coughing
Pattern: Tai Yang stage with cold

Formula: 桂枝汤 (Gui Zhi Tang, Cinnamon Twig Decoction)
Composition: 桂枝 (Gui Zhi, 9g), 白芍 (Bai Shao, 9g), 生姜 (Sheng Jiang, 9g), 大枣 (Da Zao, 3 pieces), 甘草 (Gan Cao, 6g)
Roles: 桂枝 as Jun (Chief), 白芍 as Chen (Minister), 生姜 as Zuo (Assistant), 大枣 as Zuo (Assistant), 甘草 as Shi (Envoy)
Indications: Exterior cold with sweating, mild fever, aversion to wind, floating slow pulse
Functions: Releases the exterior, harmonizes ying and wei
Pattern: Tai Yang stage with wind

Formula: 小青龙汤 (Xiao Qing Long Tang, Minor Blue Green Dragon Decoction)
Composition: 麻黄 (Ma Huang, 9g), 桂枝 (Gui Zhi, 9g), 干姜 (Gan Jiang, 9g), 细辛 (Xi Xin, 3g), 五味子 (Wu Wei Zi, 6g), 白芍 (Bai Shao, 9g), 半夏 (Ban Xia, 9g), 甘草 (Gan Cao, 6g)
Roles: 麻黄 as Jun, 桂枝 as Chen, 干姜 as Chen, 细辛 as Zuo, 五味子 as Zuo, 白芍 as Zuo, 半夏 as Zuo, 甘草 as Shi
Indications: Exterior cold with interior fluid retention, wheezing, profuse clear phlegm, cough
Functions: Releases exterior, warms the lungs, transforms phlegm, stops coughing
Pattern: Tai Yang with internal fluid retention

Formula: 大、小柴胡汤 (Da Xiao Chai Hu Tang, Major/Minor Bupleurum Decoction)
Composition: 柴胡 (Chai Hu, 12-24g), 黄芩 (Huang Qin, 9g), 党参 (Dang Shen, 9g), 半夏 (Ban Xia, 9g), 生姜 (Sheng Jiang, 9g), 大枣 (Da Zao, 4 pieces), 甘草 (Gan Cao, 6g)
Roles: 柴胡 as Jun, 黄芩 as Chen, 党参 as Chen, 半夏 as Zuo, 生姜 as Zuo, 大枣 as Zuo, 甘草 as Shi
Indications: Shaoyang stage pattern, alternating fever and chills, chest fullness, bitter taste, loss of appetite
Functions: Harmonizes Shaoyang, relieves alternating fever and chills
Pattern: Shaoyang stage

Formula: 白虎汤 (Bai Hu Tang, White Tiger Decoction)
Composition: 石膏 (Shi Gao, 30g), 知母 (Zhi Mu, 9g), 甘草 (Gan Cao, 6g), 粳米 (Jing Mi, 30g)
Roles: 石膏 as Jun, 知母 as Chen, 甘草 as Shi, 粳米 as Shi
Indications: Yangming stage with high fever, profuse sweating, severe thirst, large pulse
Functions: Clears heat, drains fire, relieves severe thirst
Pattern: Yangming stage - pure heat

Formula: 承气汤类 (Cheng Qi Tang, Purgative Decoctions)
Composition: 大黄 (Da Huang, 12g), 芒硝 (Mang Xiao, 9g), 厚朴 (Hou Po, 24g), 枳实 (Zhi Shi, 12g)
Roles: 大黄 as Jun, 芒硝 as Chen, 厚朴 as Zuo, 枳实 as Zuo
Indications: Yangming stage with internal heat accumulation, constipation, abdominal distension, tidal fever
Functions: Purges heat, empties the bowels, drains accumulation
Pattern: Yangming stage - heat accumulation

Formula: 四物汤 (Si Wu Tang, Four-Substance Decoction)
Composition: 当归 (Dang Gui, 9g), 川芎 (Chuan Xiong, 6g), 白芍 (Bai Shao, 9g), 熟地 (Shu Di, 9g)
Roles: 当归 as Jun, 川芎 as Chen, 白芍 as Chen, 熟地 as Chen
Indications: Blood deficiency patterns, menstrual disorders, dizziness, palpitations
Functions: Nourishes blood, regulates menstruation, invigorates blood
Pattern: Blood deficiency

Formula: 六味地黄汤 (Liu Wei Di Huang Tang, Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Decoction)
Composition: 熟地 (Shu Di, 24g), 山药 (Shan Yao, 12g), 山茱萸 (Shan Zhu Yu, 12g), 泽泻 (Ze Xie, 9g), 茯苓 (Fu Ling, 9g), 丹皮 (Dan Pi, 6g)
Roles: 熟地 as Jun, 山药 as Chen, 山茱萸 as Chen, 泽泻 as Zuo, 茯苓 as Zuo, 丹皮 as Zuo
Indications: Kidney yin deficiency, lower back pain, tinnitus, night sweats, dry mouth
Functions: Nourishes kidney yin, clears deficient heat
Pattern: Kidney yin deficiency
